currents.source: DS10314 Rev 8 (STM32F411xC/xE): run 100 MHz from flash, external clock, PLL on, all peripherals disabled 11.6 mA typ (20.7 mA all enabled), VDD 3.6 V, 25 °C (Table 23); Stop with flash in Stop mode and the low-power regulator 43.1 µA typ (14 µA with flash in deep power-down, if the core sets it: not checked) (Table 28). No minimum supply current stated; 100 mA is Bringup's margin

history.source: STM32duino EEPROM emulation on F4: FLASH_PAGE_SIZE 8 KB in the last flash sector, and the whole sector (128 KB on these parts) is erased on each write-back (framework-arduinoststm32 4.21200 libraries/EEPROM/src/utility/stm32_eeprom.h)

sim.note: Renode 1.17 has stm32f4 (an F407) and stm32f412 platforms, not the F411; the F412 one is close (USART1/2/6, I2C1-3) but no F411 firmware has been booted on it

motion.source: grblHAL Drivers README (github.com/grblHAL/Drivers, read 14 Nov 2026): STM32F4xx in the 'With floating point unit (FPU)' table, boards 'Blackpill / Nucleo-F411RE / Nucleo-F446RE'; Cortex-M4F single-precision FPU (DS10314 §1: Arm Cortex-M4 with FPU)

sources: DS10314 Rev 8 (Jan 2024): power supply scheme (VDD n × 100 nF + 4.7 µF; VDDA 100 nF + 1 µF, here 100 nF), Table 16 VCAP_1 4.7 µF ESR < 1 Ω with a single VCAP pin, Fig. 'NRST' 0.1 µF, boot modes (BOOT0 low: flash)

No crystal: STM32duino's generic F411CE clock (variants/STM32F4xx/F411C(C-E)(U-Y)/generic_clock.c) runs from the HSI; the Black Pill's variant needs its 25 MHz HSE. USB OTG FS needs the HSE (HSI ±1% is outside USB's tolerance), so the profile has no usb and the board doesn't wire it
Console USART1 on PA9/PA10: the pins ST's ROM bootloader also listens on (AN2606)
